why: Oct 19, 2026 (Betsy OK'd): every new state build uses the practice view (doctors grouped by the tax-ID practice they bill under; tested on Mississippi, PASS on all 21,736 codes), sizes each batch up front and splits any over slice_rows price rows, and runs one big-memory machine per state for batches still too big (one huge code). Oct 22, 2026: update mode (adding networks to a finished build) matches the build it merges into: practice view when that build has one (merge_build.py merges practice files; orchestrate_states.practice_for).
per_state_why: Oct 19, 2026 (Betsy: 'the smallest possible pieces' for the next five states): 20M-row slices instead of 30M (Colorado's batches ran 70-97M rows; New York, California and Florida have about 2-4x Colorado's providers), and for the three biggest a 64 GB big-memory machine ($0.59/h) for the one-huge-code batches Nov 3, 2026 (Betsy OK'd option 1): Washington's two page-build machines on 64 GB (m-8vcpu-64gb-intel) with a memory log, after 0 of 256 batches on 32 GB. Nov 7, 2026 (Betsy): Georgia, North Carolina and California's final assembly kept dying and restarting on 32 GB machines with every batch done; moved to 64 GB machines like Washington (Nov 3).
fieldrules_why: Nov 4, 2026 (Betsy OK'd the code review's price fixes A2-A6, then 'label, don't leave out' for capitation, bundles and expired rates): for builds that start from now on (the orchestrator passes the build's date as FIELDRULES), every insurer rate stays on the pages with a label, and the headline is the lowest rate in the best group: 0 full price, office / 1 full price, facility setting / 2 modifier / 3 derived / 4 not a total (per unit, per day, base plus per day) / 5 end date passed (judged against the build's date) / 6 capitation or bundle. Groups 4-6 and derived are left out of the page figures and the medians. A table read before Nov 4 and reused unchanged keeps its old reading (no capitation/bundle/per-unit/end-date marks) until the insurer posts a new file. Builds already under way, and update builds merging into one, keep that build's rules. Full list: Healthcare folder project-docs/PRICE-RULES.md.
